mapper.sql: id, club_id, topic_id, recurrence_type, timezone, default_lead_member_id, default_capacity, waitlist_enabled, offer_minutes, status, version, created_by_member_id, request_id, request_fingerprint, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
id, club_id, activity_id, ticket_id, member_id, state, joined_at, offered_at, offer_expires_at, offer_token_hash, registration_id, version
mapper.select: select from club_event_series where club_id = #{clubId} and (status = 'ACTIVE' or status = 'CLOSED' and exists ( select 1 from club_event_occurrence fo where fo.series_id = club_event_series.id and fo.status = 'ACTIVE' and fo.occurrence_at >= now())) order by update_time desc, id desc
select from club_event_series where id = #{seriesId} and club_id = #{clubId} and status in ('ACTIVE', 'CLOSED') limit 1

select o.id as occurrence_id, o.activity_id, o.occurrence_at, o.status, o.version, (select count(*) from cms_registration r where r.owner_type = 2 and r.owner_id = o.activity_id and r.registration_status = 2) as signup_count, (select count(*) from cms_registration r where r.owner_type = 2 and r.owner_id = o.activity_id and r.registration_status = 3) as refunded_count from club_event_occurrence o inner join club_event_series s on s.id = o.series_id and s.club_id = #{clubId} inner join cms_activity a on a.id = o.activity_id and a.club_id = #{clubId} and a.del_flag = 0 where o.series_id = #{seriesId} order by o.occurrence_at asc, o.id asc
mapper.insert: insert into club_event_series (club_id, topic_id, recurrence_type, timezone, default_lead_member_id, default_capacity, waitlist_enabled, offer_minutes, status, version, created_by_member_id, request_id, request_fingerprint, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{clubId}, #{topicId}, #{recurrenceType}, #{timezone}, #{defaultLeadMemberId}, #{defaultCapacity}, #{waitlistEnabled}, #{offerMinutes}, #{status}, #{version}, #{createdByMemberId}, #{requestId}, #{requestFingerprint}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select id from oms_ticket where owner_type = 2 and owner_id = #{activityId} and del_flag = 0 order by id asc for update
mapper.update: update oms_ticket set total_inventory = #{capacity}, remaining_inventory = #{capacity}, update_time = now() where id = #{ticketId} and owner_type = 2 and owner_id = #{activityId} and del_flag = 0 and total_inventory = remaining_inventory
mapper.insert: insert into club_event_occurrence (series_id, activity_id, occurrence_at, default_lead_member_id, status, version, create_time) values (#{seriesId}, #{activityId}, #{occurrenceAt}, #{defaultLeadMemberId}, #{status}, #{version}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select from club_event_series where id = #{seriesId} for update

select o.id, o.series_id, o.activity_id, o.occurrence_at, o.default_lead_member_id, o.status, o.version, o.create_time from club_event_occurrence o inner join cms_activity a on a.id = o.activity_id and a.del_flag = 0 where o.series_id = #{seriesId} and o.status = 'ACTIVE' and a.start_date >= #{now} and o.occurrence_at >= #{now} order by o.occurrence_at asc, o.id asc for update
mapper.sql: select s.id, s.club_id, s.topic_id, s.recurrence_type, s.timezone, s.default_lead_member_id, s.default_capacity, s.waitlist_enabled, s.offer_minutes, s.status, s.version, s.created_by_member_id, s.request_id, s.request_fingerprint, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time from club_event_series s inner join club_event_occurrence o on o.series_id = s.id and o.activity_id = #{activityId} and o.status = 'ACTIVE' inner join cms_activity a on a.id = o.activity_id and a.club_id = s.club_id and a.del_flag = 0 where s.status in ('ACTIVE', 'CLOSED')
mapper.select: for update

select s.id, s.club_id, s.topic_id, s.recurrence_type, s.timezone, s.default_lead_member_id, s.default_capacity, s.waitlist_enabled, s.offer_minutes, s.status, s.version, s.created_by_member_id, s.request_id, s.request_fingerprint, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time from club_event_series s inner join club_event_occurrence o on o.series_id = s.id and o.activity_id = #{activityId} inner join cms_activity a on a.id = o.activity_id and a.club_id = s.club_id limit 1 for update
select topic_id from cms_activity where id = #{activityId} and club_id = #{clubId} and del_flag = 0 for update

select o.id, o.series_id, o.activity_id, o.occurrence_at, o.default_lead_member_id, o.status, o.version, o.create_time from club_event_occurrence o inner join club_event_series s on s.id = o.series_id and s.club_id = #{clubId} inner join cms_activity a on a.id = o.activity_id and a.club_id = s.club_id and a.del_flag = 0 where o.activity_id = #{activityId} limit 1 for update

select a.club_id, a.id as activity_id, case when o.id is null then case when a.cancel_time is not null then 'CANCELLED' else 'ACTIVE' end else o.status end as occurrence_status, case when a.cancel_time is not null then 1 else 0 end as activity_cancelled, a.publish_status, a.cancel_reason from cms_activity a left join club_event_occurrence o on o.activity_id = a.id left join club_event_series s on s.id = o.series_id where a.id = #{activityId} and a.club_id = #{clubId} and a.del_flag = 0 and (o.id is null or s.club_id = #{clubId}) limit 1
select member_id from club_member where club_id = #{clubId} and member_id = #{memberId} and status = 1 and del_flag = 0 limit 1 for update
select from club_event_waitlist where member_id = #{memberId} and activity_id = #{activityId} and ticket_id = #{ticketId} and state in ('WAITING','OFFERED','CLAIMED') limit 1
select from club_event_waitlist where member_id = #{memberId} and activity_id = #{activityId} and ticket_id = #{ticketId} order by joined_at desc, id desc limit 1
select from club_event_waitlist where member_id = #{memberId} and activity_id = #{activityId} and ticket_id = #{ticketId} and state in ('WAITING','OFFERED','CLAIMED') limit 1 for update
select from club_event_waitlist where club_id = #{clubId} and activity_id = #{activityId} and state in ('WAITING','OFFERED','CLAIMED') order by ticket_id asc, id asc for update
mapper.update: update oms_ticket set remaining_inventory = remaining_inventory + 1, update_time = now() where id = #{ticketId} and owner_type = 2 and owner_id = #{activityId} and del_flag = 0 and remaining_inventory < total_inventory
mapper.insert: insert into club_event_waitlist (club_id, activity_id, ticket_id, member_id, state, joined_at, version) values (#{clubId}, #{activityId}, #{ticketId}, #{memberId}, #{state}, #{joinedAt}, #{version})
mapper.select: select from club_event_waitlist where activity_id = #{activityId} and ticket_id = #{ticketId} and state = 'WAITING' order by joined_at asc, id asc limit 1 for update
mapper.update: update club_event_waitlist set state = 'OFFERED', offered_at = #{offeredAt}, offer_expires_at = #{expiresAt}, offer_token_hash = #{tokenHash}, version = version + 1 where id = #{id} and state = 'WAITING' and version = #{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: select from club_event_waitlist where id = #{id} for update
select from club_event_waitlist where id = #{id}
mapper.update: update club_event_waitlist set registration_id = #{registrationId}, version = version + 1 where id = #{id} and state = 'CLAIMED' and registration_id is null
mapper.select: select from club_event_waitlist where registration_id = #{registrationId} for update
select from club_event_waitlist where registration_id = #{registrationId}
mapper.update: update club_event_waitlist set state = 'CONVERTED', version = version + 1 where registration_id = #{registrationId} and state = 'CLAIMED'
mapper.select: select max(id) from club_event_waitlist

choose.when: select min(w.id) as scanId, w.activity_id as activityId, w.ticket_id as ticketId from club_event_waitlist w inner join club_event_occurrence o on o.activity_id = w.activity_id and o.status = 'ACTIVE' inner join club_event_series s on s.id = o.series_id and s.club_id = w.club_id and s.status in ('ACTIVE', 'CLOSED') and s.waitlist_enabled = 1 inner join cms_activity a on a.id = w.activity_id and a.club_id = w.club_id and a.status = 1 and a.publish_status = 1 and a.del_flag = 0 and a.end_date > #{now} inner join oms_ticket t on t.id = w.ticket_id and t.owner_type = 2 and t.owner_id = w.activity_id and t.del_flag = 0 and t.remaining_inventory > 0 where w.state = 'WAITING' and w.id <= #{maxId} and (coalesce(t.signup_deadline, t.start_time) is null or coalesce(t.signup_deadline, t.start_time) > #{now}) group by w.activity_id, w.ticket_id having min(w.id) > #{afterId} order by scanId asc limit #{limit}

mapper.select: select w.registration_id from club_event_waitlist w inner join cms_registration r on r.id = w.registration_id where w.state = 'CLAIMED' and r.payment_status = 2 and r.registration_status = 2 order by w.id asc limit #{limit}

select w.registration_id from club_event_waitlist w inner join cms_registration r on r.id = w.registration_id where w.state = 'CLAIMED' and (r.registration_status in (3, 4) or r.payment_status in (3, 4)) order by w.id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update club_event_waitlist w inner join cms_registration r on r.id = w.registration_id set w.state = 'EXPIRED', w.version = w.version + 1 where w.registration_id = #{registrationId} and w.state = 'CLAIMED' and (r.registration_status in (3, 4) or r.payment_status in (3, 4))
mapper.select: select w.activity_id as activityId, w.ticket_id as ticketId from club_event_waitlist w inner join club_event_occurrence o on o.activity_id = w.activity_id and o.status = 'ACTIVE' inner join club_event_series s on s.id = o.series_id and s.club_id = w.club_id and s.status in ('ACTIVE', 'CLOSED') and s.waitlist_enabled = 1 inner join cms_activity a on a.id = w.activity_id and a.club_id = w.club_id and a.status = 1 and a.publish_status = 1 and a.del_flag = 0 and a.end_date > #{now} inner join oms_ticket t on t.id = w.ticket_id and t.owner_type = 2 and t.owner_id = w.activity_id and t.del_flag = 0 and t.remaining_inventory > 0 where w.state = 'WAITING' and (coalesce(t.signup_deadline, t.start_time) is null or coalesce(t.signup_deadline, t.start_time) > #{now}) group by w.activity_id, w.ticket_id order by min(w.joined_at) asc, min(w.id) asc limit #{limit}

select paid.member_id as memberId, coalesce(nullif(m.nickname, ''), nullif(m.name, ''), concat('成员#', paid.member_id)) as nickname, coalesce(ck.arrived_at, paid.verified_at, progress.arrived_at) as baseArrivedAt, case when ck.arrived_at is not null or paid.verified_count > 0 or progress.arrived_count > 0 then 1 else 0 end as baseArrived, corr.new_arrived as correctedArrived, corr.new_arrived_at as correctedArrivedAt, coalesce(corr.version, 0) as correctionVersion from ( select member_id, sum(verification_status = 1) as verified_count, min(case when verification_status = 1 then verification_time else null end) as verified_at from cms_registration where owner_type = 2 and owner_id = #{activityId} and payment_status = 2 and registration_status = 2 group by member_id ) paid left join ums_member m on m.id = paid.member_id and m.del_flag = 0 left join club_lead_checkin ck on ck.activity_id = #{activityId} and ck.member_id = paid.member_id left join ( select member_id, min(checkin_time) as arrived_at, count(*) as arrived_count from player_node_progress where activity_id = #{activityId} and status = 1 and del_flag = 0 group by member_id ) progress on progress.member_id = paid.member_id left join club_event_attendance_correction corr on corr.id = ( select max(c2.id) from club_event_attendance_correction c2 where c2.activity_id = #{activityId} and c2.member_id = paid.member_id ) order by paid.member_id asc

select w.member_id as memberId, coalesce(nullif(m.nickname, ''), nullif(m.name, ''), concat('成员#', w.member_id)) as nickname, w.ticket_id as ticketId, w.state, w.joined_at as joinedAt, w.offer_expires_at as offerExpiresAt from club_event_waitlist w left join ums_member m on m.id = w.member_id and m.del_flag = 0 where w.activity_id = #{activityId} and w.state in ('WAITING','OFFERED','CLAIMED') order by w.joined_at asc, w.id asc

select r.member_id as memberId, 1 as paidCount, coalesce(ck.arrived_at, (select min(v.verification_time) from cms_registration v where v.owner_type = 2 and v.owner_id = #{activityId} and v.member_id = #{memberId} and v.payment_status = 2 and v.registration_status = 2 and v.verification_status = 1), (select min(p.checkin_time) from player_node_progress p where p.activity_id = #{activityId} and p.member_id = #{memberId} and p.status = 1 and p.del_flag = 0)) as baseArrivedAt, case when ck.arrived_at is not null or exists (select 1 from cms_registration v where v.owner_type = 2 and v.owner_id = #{activityId} and v.member_id = #{memberId} and v.payment_status = 2 and v.registration_status = 2 and v.verification_status = 1) or exists (select 1 from player_node_progress p where p.activity_id = #{activityId} and p.member_id = #{memberId} and p.status = 1 and p.del_flag = 0) then 1 else 0 end as baseArrived from cms_registration r left join club_lead_checkin ck on ck.activity_id = r.owner_id and ck.member_id = r.member_id where r.owner_type = 2 and r.owner_id = #{activityId} and r.member_id = #{memberId} and r.payment_status = 2 and r.registration_status = 2 order by r.id asc limit 1 for update

select id, club_id as clubId, activity_id as activityId, member_id as memberId, original_arrived as originalArrived, new_arrived as newArrived, original_arrived_at as originalArrivedAt, new_arrived_at as newArrivedAt, reason, actor_member_id as actorMemberId, request_id as requestId, version, corrected_at as correctedAt from club_event_attendance_correction where activity_id = #{activityId} and member_id = #{memberId} order by version desc limit 1 for update

select id, club_id as clubId, activity_id as activityId, member_id as memberId, original_arrived as originalArrived, new_arrived as newArrived, original_arrived_at as originalArrivedAt, new_arrived_at as newArrivedAt, reason, actor_member_id as actorMemberId, request_id as requestId, version, corrected_at as correctedAt from club_event_attendance_correction where actor_member_id = #{actorMemberId} and request_id = #{requestId} limit 1 for update
mapper.insert: insert into club_event_attendance_correction (club_id, activity_id, member_id, original_arrived, new_arrived, original_arrived_at, new_arrived_at, reason, actor_member_id, request_id, version, corrected_at) values (#{clubId}, #{activityId}, #{memberId}, #{originalArrived}, #{newArrived}, #{originalArrivedAt}, #{newArrivedAt}, #{reason}, #{actorMemberId}, #{requestId}, #{version}, #{correctedAt})
mapper.sql: id, club_id, activity_id, audience_type, channel, title, content, status, actor_member_id, request_id, total_count, success_count, failed_count, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: select from club_event_notification_campaign where club_id = #{clubId} and actor_member_id = #{actorMemberId} and request_id = #{requestId} limit 1
select from club_event_notification_campaign where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into club_event_notification_campaign (club_id, activity_id, audience_type, channel, title, content, status, actor_member_id, request_id, total_count, success_count, failed_count, create_time, update_time) values (#{clubId}, #{activityId}, #{audienceType}, #{channel}, #{title}, #{content}, #{status}, #{actorMemberId}, #{requestId}, #{totalCount}, #{successCount}, #{failedCount}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select member_id from ( select c.member_id from club c where c.id = #{clubId} and c.status = 1 and c.del_flag = 0 union select cm.member_id from club_member cm inner join club c on c.id = cm.club_id and c.status = 1 and c.del_flag = 0 where cm.club_id = #{clubId} and cm.status = 1 and cm.del_flag = 0 ) recipients order by member_id asc

select member_id from ( select c.member_id from club c where c.id = #{clubId} and c.status = 1 and c.del_flag = 0 union select cra.target_member_id from club_role_assignment cra inner join club_member cm on cm.club_id = cra.club_id and cm.member_id = cra.target_member_id and cm.status = 1 and cm.del_flag = 0 where cra.club_id = #{clubId} and cra.scope_type = 'CLUB' and cra.scope_id = #{clubId} and cra.role_code in ('CLUB_CO_OWNER','CLUB_OPERATOR') and cra.status = 'ACTIVE' and (cra.expires_at is null or cra.expires_at > now()) ) recipients order by member_id asc

select distinct r.member_id from cms_registration r inner join cms_activity a on a.id = r.owner_id and a.club_id = #{clubId} and a.del_flag = 0 where r.owner_type = 2 and r.owner_id = #{activityId} and r.payment_status = 2 and r.registration_status = 2 order by r.member_id asc

select distinct w.member_id from club_event_waitlist w inner join cms_activity a on a.id = w.activity_id and a.club_id = w.club_id and a.del_flag = 0 where w.club_id = #{clubId} and w.activity_id = #{activityId} and w.state in ('WAITING','OFFERED','CLAIMED') order by w.member_id asc

select distinct r.member_id from cms_registration r inner join cms_activity a on a.id = r.owner_id and a.club_id = #{clubId} and a.id = #{activityId} and a.del_flag = 0 and a.end_date <= now() left join club_lead_checkin ck on ck.activity_id = a.id and ck.member_id = r.member_id left join club_event_attendance_correction corr on corr.id = ( select max(c2.id) from club_event_attendance_correction c2 where c2.activity_id = a.id and c2.member_id = r.member_id ) where r.owner_type = 2 and r.payment_status = 2 and r.registration_status = 2 and case when corr.id is not null then corr.new_arrived = 0 else ck.id is null end order by r.member_id asc

select members.member_id from ( select c.member_id from club c where c.id = #{clubId} and c.status = 1 and c.del_flag = 0 union select cm.member_id from club_member cm where cm.club_id = #{clubId} and cm.status = 1 and cm.del_flag = 0 ) members where not exists ( select 1 from cms_registration r inner join cms_activity a on a.id = r.owner_id and a.club_id = #{clubId} and a.del_flag = 0 where r.owner_type = 2 and r.member_id = members.member_id and r.payment_status = 2 and r.registration_status = 2 and r.payment_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 90 day) ) order by members.member_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into club_event_notification_delivery (campaign_id, recipient_member_id, channel, status, attempt_count, version, create_time, update_time) values (#{campaignId}, #{recipientMemberId}, #{channel}, #{status}, #{attemptCount}, #{version}, now(), now())
insert into club_event_notification_outbox (delivery_id, status, next_attempt_at, create_time, update_time) values (#{deliveryId}, 'PENDING', #{nextAttemptAt}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update club_event_notification_outbox set next_attempt_at = #{leaseUntil}, update_time = now() where delivery_id = #{deliveryId} and status = 'PENDING' and next_attempt_at <= now()
mapper.select: select d.id, d.campaign_id, d.recipient_member_id, d.channel, d.status, d.attempt_count, d.message_id, d.last_error, d.sent_at, d.version from club_event_notification_delivery d inner join club_event_notification_outbox o on o.delivery_id = d.id and o.status = 'PENDING' and o.next_attempt_at <= now() where d.campaign_id = #{campaignId} and d.status in ('PENDING','FAILED') and d.attempt_count < 5 order by d.id asc limit #{limit} for update

select d.id, d.campaign_id, d.recipient_member_id, d.channel, d.status, d.attempt_count, d.message_id, d.last_error, d.sent_at, d.version from club_event_notification_delivery d where d.id = #{id} for update

choose.when:
select exists ( select 1 from cms_registration r inner join cms_activity a on a.id = r.owner_id and a.club_id = #{clubId} and a.id = #{activityId} and a.del_flag = 0 and a.end_date <= now() inner join club c on c.id = a.club_id and c.status = 1 and c.del_flag = 0 left join club_lead_checkin ck on ck.activity_id = a.id and ck.member_id = r.member_id left join club_event_attendance_correction corr on corr.id = ( select max(c2.id) from club_event_attendance_correction c2 where c2.activity_id = a.id and c2.member_id = r.member_id ) where r.owner_type = 2 and r.member_id = #{recipientMemberId} and r.payment_status = 2 and r.registration_status = 2 and case when corr.id is not null then corr.new_arrived = 0 else ck.id is null end
)

mapper.update: update club_event_notification_delivery set status = 'FAILED', attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, last_error = #{lastError}, version = version + 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status in ('PENDING','FAILED') and version = #{expectedVersion}

update club_event_notification_delivery set status = 'SKIPPED_INELIGIBLE', message_id = null, sent_at = null, last_error = 'RECIPIENT_NO_LONGER_ELIGIBLE', version = version + 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status in ('PENDING','FAILED') and version = #{expectedVersion}
update club_event_notification_outbox set status = 'COMPLETED', update_time = now() where delivery_id = #{deliveryId} and status = 'PENDING'
update club_event_notification_outbox set next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, update_time = now() where delivery_id = #{deliveryId} and status = 'PENDING'

update club_event_notification_campaign c set total_count = (select count(*) from club_event_notification_delivery d where d.campaign_id = c.id), success_count = (select count(*) from club_event_notification_delivery d where d.campaign_id = c.id and d.status = 'SENT'), failed_count = (select count(*) from club_event_notification_delivery d where d.campaign_id = c.id and d.status = 'FAILED'), status = case when exists (select 1 from club_event_notification_delivery d where d.campaign_id = c.id and d.status = 'FAILED') then 'PARTIAL_FAILED' when exists (select 1 from club_event_notification_delivery d where d.campaign_id = c.id and d.status = 'PENDING') then 'PROCESSING' else 'COMPLETED' end, update_time = now() where c.id = #{campaignId}
